'''2018 European MPC Results Ralf Wachowiak LS He Is The Chosen One''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ralf Wachowiak]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ralf Wachowiak]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance|V8-L-heisthechosenone.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open He Is The Chosen One Wachowiak LS.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-match-play-championships/ PC list]
